# Website and Integrations

Publish web pages and web forms, and connect Frappe to other services.

| Page | What it covers |
|---|---|
| [Website](website.md) | Publish Web Pages, Web Forms, blog posts and newsletters, set up the site header, footer and home page in Website Settings, run the portal for website users, and track visits. |
| [Integrations](integrations.md) | Connect a Frappe site to other systems with Webhooks, OAuth clients, Connected Apps, Social Login Keys, LDAP, Google settings, push notifications and Dropbox, Google Drive or S3 backups. |
